2026-09-12 (later same day): scenario-shape fix, user request "1 scenario is enough, also make it use cast, not just some mythical enter." This card already had exactly 1 scenario (the prior migration's own consolidation), so the real work was the second half: the existing scenario used a top-level `trigger:'onEnter'`, which starts `self` already on the Battlefield and skips `cast`/`enters` outright — the same shortcut paladin-s-arms/sage-s-nouliths/white-mage-s-staff/astrologian-s-planisphere's own 2026-09-12 (earlier) fixes all still use too, all blocked by a genuine, previously-documented structural harness.ts gap (`isActivationCostPermanentBaselineFact`, verify-synergy.mjs: "the harness has no scenario field that bypasses this branch" for a permanent with its own `activationCost`). Closed that gap for real instead of working around it: new `Scenario.forceCast` (harness.ts) lets a scenario opt a card with `activationCost` back into a genuine `cast`(Hand)->`enters`(Battlefield) lifecycle — `lifecycleBefore`/`selfZone`/`lifecycleAfter` all gained a `&& !scenario.forceCast` guard alongside their existing `card.activationCost` checks (fully backward-compatible: every other scenario in the pool leaves `forceCast` unset, so `!undefined` is always true and old behavior is byte-identical — confirmed via full-pool verify-synergy/vitest below). Also guarded the top-level `resolveCard(...)` call in `runScenario`: when `forceCast` + `activationCost` are both set, that call is skipped entirely rather than falling through to the no-trigger/no-ability branch, which would otherwise auto-fire `card.effects` (this card's OWN Equip {4} ability) as if casting the permanent for real; the real activation now only fires later via the scenario's own `sequence` step's `activate:true`, paying real activation semantics instead of a free unintended one. New scenario (`forceCast:true`, `sequence:['onEnter', {activate:true}]`, `you:{creaturesCount:1}`): a real, continuous cast -> enters -> Job select ETB trigger (creates the 1/1 Hero token, auto-attaches) -> real Equip {4} activation (re-attaches to the OTHER real creature already on the battlefield) — regenerated trace.json (`run-scenarios.mjs --slug=dragoon-s-lance`) confirms the real `cast`/`enters`/`trigger`/`activate`/`equip`x2 log shape, no `activate` double-fire. verify-synergy.mjs scoped (OK) and full pool (317 v2 cards checked, 8 pre-existing hard failures, all on files actively mid-edit by concurrent sessions per `git status` at the time — cargo-ship, cecil-dark-knight-cecil-redeemed-paladin, dragoon-s-wyvern, il-mheg-pixie, stiltzkin-moogle-merchant, the-wind-crystal, white-auracite, zack-fair — none touched here, none newly broken by this change). vitest run functional-model: 238/238 (unchanged). tsc --noEmit: 0 errors. Live-verified via `curl localhost:3000/api/card/fin/17`: `functionalModel.traces` is a length-1 array whose single trace's `log` starts `cast`->`enters`->`trigger:onEnter`->`createToken`->`equip`->`activate`->`equip`, matching the regenerated trace.json exactly — the card page's Scenarios tab now genuinely shows the real cast lifecycle rather than the old shortcut. Did NOT retrofit the sibling family (paladin-s-arms/sage-s-nouliths/white-mage-s-staff/astrologian-s-planisphere) onto the new `forceCast` mechanism — out of this task's stated scope (dragoon-s-lance only); they remain correct under the OLD (now-superseded-for-this-card) house style and are good future-upgrade candidates, flagged in ENGINE_GAPS.md.

2026-09-12 (earlier): real split of the 2 previously-inert static clauses. 'During your turn, equipped creature has flying' is now REAL, executable machinery — generalized ENGINE_GAPS.md gap #14's `continuousKeywordGrants` with a new `equippedBySelf` mode (checks the real, live `RealCard.attachedToId` link instead of a subtype/controller match; verified functionally with a throwaway script: false unequipped, true equipped-on-your-turn, false equipped-on-opponent's-turn). New real fact `{event:'grantKeyword', keyword:'Flying', target:{equippedBySelf:true}, value:-1}` — evidence-exempted via a new, shape-scoped (not card-name-scoped) `isEquippedKeywordGrantFact` in verify-synergy.mjs: this card's plain harness.ts Scenario[] style can't inject the manual `read:hasKeyword` line the evidence would need (same structural wall Ardyn's own grant facts hit), reusable for any future Equipment-broadcast turn-conditional grant. The '+1/+0 and is a Knight' clause stays split into two real facts, still honest-but-structurally-inert (no continuous-effect/layer-7c pipeline for a static bonus flowing to whatever's equipped, no dynamic type-grant-to-another-permanent pipeline anywhere — checked card.ts's animate dispatch, self-only): `{event:'pump', power:1, toughness:0, target:{equippedBySelf:true}}` and new vocabulary `{event:'grantType', type:'Knight', target:{equippedBySelf:true}}`, both exempted by name-scoped checks. Also fixed a real, pre-existing camelCase display bug found along the way: `grantKeyword` (already real, live vocabulary via Dion/Ardyn/haste-magic/circle-of-power) had never gotten an explicit describeFact branch, so it rendered raw ('GrantKeyword') same bug class as `preventDamage` — added real branches for `grantKeyword` -> 'grant keyword' and the new `grantType` -> 'grant type' (synergy.ts); updated synergy.test.ts's own fallback example off `grantKeyword` (no longer unrecognized) onto `surveil`. compute-annotations.mjs re-run (7 facts annotated). verify-synergy.mjs (scoped: OK, 0 hard/soft; full pool 314: 0 hard failures). vitest 238/238. tsc --noEmit baseline unchanged (45).

2026-09-11: migrated to the unified Fact/annotations model (fin/17, continuation of the fin/1-10 rollout). Real oracle text (data/fin/fin_scryfall.json, collector_number 17): "Job select (When this Equipment enters, create a 1/1 colorless Hero creature token, then attach this to it.)\nEquipped creature gets +1/+0 and is a Knight in addition to its other types.\nDuring your turn, equipped creature has flying.\nGae Bolg — Equip {4}". Mana cost {1}{W}, type line "Artifact — Equipment" — both verified against fin_scryfall.json, unchanged from the pre-existing definition.ts. 2 pre-existing facts (1 source token-creation, 1 sink wants-creature-to-equip, both old id/sourceText/highlight shape) -> 4 facts (3 source, 1 sink) after adding baseline self-cast/self-enters and converting the two pre-existing facts to the new to/from/annotations shape. self-cast: {event:'cast', from:'Hand', target:'self', value:-1}, typeLine-anchored ('Artifact'). self-enters: {event:'entersBattlefield', to:'Battlefield', subject:'self', target:'self', value:-1} — per this rollout's explicit instruction, carries BOTH subject AND target (unlike summon-bahamut's own self-enters, which only ever had target — see SYNERGY_DESIGN.md's 'Fact unification' section for why that card's self-enters was deliberately left subject-less); adding subject here is what lets this Equipment's own real entering satisfy a TYPE-CONSTRAINED 'wants Artifact/Equipment' sink for the first time (confirmed via the required find-synergies.mjs diff: 29 new genuine matches — Adelbert Steiner's own 'wants-equipment' sink among them — none of them spurious, every one spot-checked against a real Artifact/Equipment-aware want). Job-select token-creation fact converted from the old bare {zone:'Battlefield', subject:{token:'c_1_1_hero'}} to {event:'entersBattlefield', to:'Battlefield', controller:'you', subject:{token:'c_1_1_hero'}, value:1} — same real shape aerith-rescue-mission's own migrated token fact already established; value:1 kept as a real, directly-known magnitude (creates exactly one token), not run through compute-weights.mjs. Equip sink converted from {zone:...} to {to:'Battlefield', controller:'you', types:{has:['Creature']}}, value:1 unchanged — confirmed via find-synergies.mjs diff that its own match set (98 lines, X-->Dragoon's Lance direction) is byte-identical before/after, as expected (zone->to is representational only). New annotations-authoring.json (4 entries, positionally aligned) baked via compute-annotations.mjs — all 4 facts carry real, verified spans (2 typeLine, 2 oracle). Added 'dragoon-s-lance' to scripts/annotation-coverage.mjs's ANNOTATED_CARD_SLUGS. No 'equip' event fact added anywhere (the actual attach action, both via Job select's auto-attach and the Equip {4} activated ability, stays covered by the existing parked fn:'equip' — PARKED_ACTION_FNS — same treatment every other Equipment in the pool already gets; no new vocabulary invented). 'Equipped creature gets +1/+0 and is a Knight...'/'During your turn, equipped creature has flying' deliberately left as staticAbilities text only, NOT modeled as Facts — checked established, repeated pool precedent first (dark-knight-s-greatsword/buster-sword/lion-heart/black-mage-s-rod's own identical '+N/+0 and is a Type' clause; kain-traitorous-dragoon/tonberry/yuna-hope-of-spira's own identical 'during your turn, has KEYWORD' clause) — every one of those already-committed sibling cards leaves the equivalent clause as text-only with no Fact and no Effect, because no Effect kind exists anywhere in this model for a static bonus/type-grant/conditional-keyword-grant applied to WHATEVER creature is equipped (only self-targeted pump/animate/grantKeywordSelf exist), and no whose-turn-is-it tracking exists for the 'during your turn' half either. No new vocabulary invented for this (crystal-fragments-summon-alexander's own 'equipped creature' migration had not landed at the time this card was done — checked its current definition.ts/synergy.ts diff, found no new 'equipped creature' target convention yet — so this card's resolution rests on the OTHER, already-committed sibling precedent, not on a sibling task's landing). All checks green: verify-synergy.mjs scoped (dragoon-s-lance: OK) and full pool (314 v2 cards checked, 1 pre-existing unrelated hard failure on dwarven-castle-guard from concurrent sibling work, not touched here). vitest run functional-model: 238/238 passed (unchanged); annotation-coverage.test.ts: 5/5 passed.
knownGaps: 2026-09-12 (gap #14 fully closed): all three static clauses ('has flying' / 'gets +1/+0' / 'is a Knight') are now real, executable, query-time machinery (`continuousKeywordGrants`/`continuousPTGrants`/`continuousTypeGrants`) — no longer a gap. The only remaining limitation is EVIDENCE, not mechanism: this card's own `pump`/`grantType` facts still can't show a real trace line, since this card's own `scenarios.ts` is a plain `harness.ts` Scenario[] with no manual-log-injection field (same structural wall the Flying grant's own fact already had) — a future migration to an `engine-trace.ts` pilot script (same style Crystal Fragments now uses) could close that evidence gap too, not attempted here (out of scope — see this file's own dedicated evidence-migration note above). Other Equipment cards in the pool with an identical P/T+type clause shape (dark-knight-s-greatsword, buster-sword, lion-heart, black-mage-s-rod) were NOT touched by this pass — real, ready candidates for the same `continuousPTGrants`/`continuousTypeGrants` migration, flagged for a future sweep, not assumed closed for free.

The Job select auto-attach ('...then attach this to it') and the Equip {4} activated ability's own attach action are both real, executed (actions.equip), but carry no Fact/event vocabulary — 'equip' stays on verify-synergy.mjs's PARKED_ACTION_FNS list pool-wide (no card in the corpus wants an 'equip' event today); only the token-creation half of Job select and the equip sink's own 'wants a creature to attach to' half are represented as Facts.

2026-09-12 (later): the 'no real cast/enters possible for an activationCost permanent' harness.ts gap is now CLOSED (new Scenario.forceCast) — no longer a gap for THIS card.
